reports.title: Alvotech Announces Financial Results for the Nine Months to September 30, 2026, with a Business Update

guidance.heading: Outlook for the Full Year 2026
section: Alvotech maintains its full-year 2026 guidance for total revenue of $650-$700 million and EBITDA of $180-$220 million, with performance now expected toward the lower end of the range. The Company remains focused on executing planned product deliveries in the fourth quarter, as production and commercial supply continue to ramp up following the manufacturing improvement program completed in the first half of the year.

desk.headline: Revenue dips 2% to $111.6m, below estimates, as product sales jump 78%; 2026 outlook kept but now seen at the low end
results: Total revenue slipped 2% to $111.6m as lower licence and milestone income offset a 78% rise in product and service sales to $58.2m.
Adjusted EBITDA more than doubled to $31.5m from $14.4m, helped by much lower research spending.
Over nine months, revenue fell 23% to $323.4m and the net loss was $140.7m ($0.45 a share); no separate quarterly EPS was given.
The FDA approved a second Simlandi production suite in Reykjavik and a new process that more than doubles output per batch.
Cash fell to $61.5m from $172.4m at the start of the year, with borrowings of about $1.34bn.

guidance.summary: Alvotech kept its 2026 targets of $650–700m revenue and $180–220m EBITDA, but now expects to land toward the lower end, relying on heavy fourth-quarter deliveries.

points: Management expects Q4 to be the strongest quarter in the company's history, citing a strong order book into 2027.
The CFO said the low end of guidance holds even if December FDA decisions slip; revenue from milestones and product sales can be lumpy.
FDA decisions on the Simponi, Eylea and Prolia biosimilars are due in December; the US Simponi launch also hinges on a court ruling.
Cash flow from operations is expected to turn positive in Q4; management said more capital could be raised if needed.
No 2027 guidance yet, but management expects meaningful growth, with debt reduction expected to start in the second half of 2027.
call.source: Press release (Exhibit 99.1) and the Q3 2026 call transcript: The Motley Fool, 12 Nov 2026

watch: Whether Q4 deliveries are big enough to reach the low end of the $650–700m revenue range.
December FDA decisions on three biosimilars and the court ruling affecting the US Simponi launch.
Cash of $61.5m against about $1.34bn of borrowings, and any new funding.
